chunks: We never sent an admonisher to a habitation but its well-to-do people said: "We do not believe in what you have brought."
ai.seo_question: Why did the wealthy reject the prophets?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Saba (34:45) underscores the sociological dynamic where material prosperity often breeds spiritual arrogance, leading the 'mutrafūn' (the affluent elite) to dismiss prophetic warnings as threats to their status. This pattern illustrates that rejection of divine guidance is frequently rooted in worldly attachment rather than intellectual deficiency, a theme central to understanding the historical resistance faced by the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams. The verse serves as a timeless reminder that true humility requires overcoming the ego's reliance on temporal power.
